# debug

open fun [debug](debug.html)(cause: [Throwable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/latest/jvm/stdlib/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-throwable/index.html)? = null, msg: () -> [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/latest/jvm/stdlib/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html))

Logs a message at the [Level.DEBUG](../-level/-d-e-b-u-g/index.html) level.

#### Parameters

 _cause_

An optional [Throwable](https://kotlinlang.org/api/latest/jvm/stdlib/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-throwable/index.html) to log along with the message.

_msg_

A lambda returning the string message to log. It is only evaluated if the given level is enabled.
